persona_full:
[Who I am]
- I am a woman.
- I am 50 years old.
- I live in Gujarat.
- The place I live in has 5,000-10,000 inhabitants.
- I am Muslim.
- I am married.
- I have 2 children.
- I live with my parents.
- My education: no formal education.
- I can read and write.

[Work and money]
- My work situation: housewife, not otherwise employed.
- I am not the chief wage earner in my household.
- I would describe my family as lower middle class.
- On a ladder of household incomes in India from 1 (lowest) to 10 (highest), my household is at 4.
- In the past year my family spent some savings.
- My satisfaction with my household's financial situation, from 1 (completely dissatisfied) to 10 (completely satisfied): 2.
- In the last 12 months my family has rarely gone without enough food to eat.
- In the last 12 months my family has rarely gone without a cash income.

[My life]
- Taking all things together, I am very happy.
- My health these days is fair.
- My satisfaction with my life as a whole, from 1 (completely dissatisfied) to 10 (completely satisfied): 10.
- How much free choice and control I feel I have over my life, from 1 (none at all) to 10 (a great deal): 2.
- In my neighbourhood I feel very secure.
- Family is very important in my life.
- Friends are rather important in my life.
- Work is very important in my life.
- Politics is not at all important in my life.
- Religion is very important in my life.

[Religion]
- Apart from weddings and funerals, I attend religious services more than once a week.
- How important God is in my life, from 1 (not at all important) to 10 (very important): 10.

[How I see other people]
- My family: I trust them completely.
- People in my neighbourhood: I do not trust them at all.
- People I know personally: I do not trust them at all.
- People of another religion: I do not trust them at all.
- People of another nationality: I do not trust them at all.

[What kind of person I am]
- Thinking up new ideas and being creative, doing things my own way: very much like me.
- Being rich, having a lot of money and expensive things: not at all like me.
- Living in secure surroundings, avoiding anything that might be dangerous: not like me.
- Always behaving properly, avoiding anything people would say is wrong: very much like me.
- Tradition, following the customs handed down by my religion or family: very much like me.

[My views]
- I am not at all interested in politics.
- From 1 (incomes should be made more equal) to 10 (we need larger income differences as incentives for individual effort), my view is 3.
- From 1 (competition is good) to 10 (competition is harmful), my view is 1.
- Cheating on taxes if you have a chance, from 1 (never justifiable) to 10 (always justifiable): 1.
- I am quite proud to be Indian.

[How I get information]
- How often I read a daily newspaper: never.
- How often I watch TV news: daily.
- How often I use the internet: never.
